```{python}
#| label: setup
import altair as alt
import polars as pl

alt.data_transformers.disable_max_rows()
# SVG so chart colours are CSS-resolvable; canvas would bake them in
alt.renderers.set_embed_options(renderer="svg")


@alt.theme.register("adaptive", enable=True)
def adaptive() -> alt.theme.ThemeConfig:
    # currentColor inherits the page text colour, so charts follow the
    # light/dark theme without re-rendering
    fg = "currentColor"
    return alt.theme.ThemeConfig(
        config={
            "background": "transparent",
            "view": {"stroke": fg, "strokeOpacity": 0.2},
            "title": {"color": fg, "subtitleColor": fg},
            "axis": {
                "labelColor": fg,
                "titleColor": fg,
                "domainColor": fg,
                "domainOpacity": 0.4,
                "tickColor": fg,
                "tickOpacity": 0.4,
                "gridColor": fg,
                "gridOpacity": 0.1,
            },
            "legend": {"labelColor": fg, "titleColor": fg},
            "header": {"labelColor": fg, "titleColor": fg},
            "text": {"color": fg},
        }
    )
```
